features.heading: Our Services
features.description: These are the services we provide, these Makes us stand apart

items.title: IMPLANT DENTISTRY
items.description: Advanced dental implant solutions for replacing missing teeth with natural-looking and durable results.

items.title: ROOT CANAL TREATMENT
items.description: Professional endodontic care to treat infected tooth pulp and save natural teeth.

items.title: ORTHODONTIC TREATMENT
items.description: Dental alignment and correction treatments, including braces and clear aligners, for improved smile and bite.

items.title: COSMETIC DENTISTRY
items.description: Aesthetic dental procedures to enhance the appearance of teeth, including whitening, veneers, and bonding.

about.title: About us
about.description: Dr Zainu's Multi Speciality Dental Clinic & Implant Centre is a comprehensive dental care provider located at N.H Kolappuram. The clinic offers a wide range of treatments including implant dentistry, root canal, orthodontics, pediatric dentistry, and cosmetic procedures, supported by a panel of specialized doctors.
